name: Base-100 Arithmetic Set Packing
description: Replaced the matrix trace condition with an arithmetic condition. Each variable is mapped to a large integer where its participation in input pairs is encoded as positional values in base 100. The requirement that the sum of $k$ chosen integers has no digit greater than 1 in base 100 perfectly encodes the Independent Set condition (since $k \le 46 < 100$, carries are mathematically impossible), but forces the model to either simulate big-integer arithmetic (which will Time Out) or perform a multi-step deduction to recover the conflict graph.
